portableConditions.regexEngineLimits: Portable shorthand cases cover ASCII digit and word classes, their negations on BMP characters, escaped literals, and case insensitive word shorthand outside character classes. Astral and other UTF-16 code unit distinctions, case insensitive word shorthand inside character classes, and broader regular expression engine equivalence are not guaranteed. Whitespace shorthand retains each native engine's current behaviour.
